rust.name: src/store.rs:475:9: replace Store::end_session -> Result<(), String> with Ok(())
rust.why: The merged test starts two children in the same store, so checking the session records after the first exits could expose stale state that the launch assertions miss.

rust.name: src/pick.rs:93:53: replace > with >= in pick
rust.why: The launch assertions check which account is selected, and this comparison only changes the decision when its operands are equal.

rust.name: src/run.rs:302:5: replace release_signals with ()
rust.why: An ordinary child exit can still pass with signals left blocked, and neither launch in the diff exercises delivery of a signal.

rust.name: src/login.rs:103:5: replace written -> Option<u64> with Some(0)
rust.why: The merged test checks the child's credential and selected account without checking the recorded login time.

rust.name: src/order.rs:107:21: replace match guard r.models.is_empty() with false in walk
rust.why: The visible launches use either no order or an order with an explicit model, leaving room for a regression in an order entry that names only an engine.
